title: The platform had been serving a 2026-08-18 registry: the cluster sync had been hung since 2026-08-03
symptom: Quarantine badges rendered empty because the dashboard's registry had 60 datasets and no governance fields; ps showed one rsync alive for 20 days 18 hours.
root_cause: A blocked ssh; systemd will not start a new run while the old one lives, so the timer simply stopped without ever reporting a failure. The recorded cause (a stale askpass password) was a guess.
correction_made: Process killed, service restarted, registry re-pulled, fix_local_paths re-run, UI verified. A staleness alarm was added to the corrective list.
